text: {"S590":{"about":["kubelet"],"refers":[],"why":"The kubelet restarts failed containers in Pods according to their restart policy."},"S591":{"about":["kube-controller-manager"],"refers":[],"why":"Deployment and StatefulSet controllers create replacement Pods to maintain replicas."},"S592":{"about":["kube-controller-manager"],"refers":[],"why":"The DaemonSet controller replaces failed Pods on their assigned nodes."},"S593":{"about":["kube-controller-manager"],"refers":[],"why":"Volume attachment recovery is handled by control-loop behavior in the controller manager."},"S594":{"about":["kube-controller-manager","kube-proxy"],"refers":[],"why":"Controllers update Service endpoints and kube-proxy routes Service traffic using those healthy endpoints."}}
